## Checklist
- [ ] Implementation Plan was approved by the owner (milestone work)

- [ ] Security implications reviewed (input, links, uploads, persistence)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files staged; no unrelated changes

- [ ] New dependencies justified below (or none)
